headlines.text: That Saturday in 2019, Chris Jericho vs. Adam Page etched their names into history in the first-ever AEW World Heavyweight Title match, appearing on All Out, rated 6.95. The culmination of months of build since Double or Nothing, with Page even riding a horse to the ring ? Jericho's experience won out on the night, though Page's performance was so well-received that Cody publicly called him the best wrestler in The Elite afterward.

Back on this day in 2022, The Elite vs. United Empire met in a Tournament Match, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 8.69 ? a genuine showstealer. Chicago's go-home Dynamite before All Out saw Kenny Omega return in full force, hitting Aussie Open's Kyle Fletcher with the One Winged Angel to send The Elite through to the trios final ? then getting jumped by United Empire after the cameras stopped rolling.

On a Saturday in 2024, back when Hikaru Shida vs. Queen Aminata vs. Serena Deeb vs. Thunder Rosa met in a Number One Contender, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 7.28 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2019, when The Lucha Brothers vs. The Young Bucks settled things in a Ladder match on All Out, rated 9.17 ? a stone-cold classic in a hard-hitting tag team clash, on an outstanding All Out '19 show that earned an overall rating of 8.03. A ladder war that earned the loudest praise of the entire show ? critics singled this out as the best match on the card, a masterclass in everything the two teams could do against each other.
